answer: A sybil cluster splitting funds across many wallets creates a detectable ripple in transaction graph density, flagged for higher bond requirements. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked to its identity, and every epoch a random beacon selects a small jury whose members cross-verify stake provenance. Attackers then must lock real capital per fake identity, making mass forgery economically unprofitable. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
